business_problem: VOGSY needed an affordable, approachable cloud platform to run a globally available ERP product for project-based firms while preserving scalability, uptime, and room to add new AI-driven capabilities.
solution_summary: VOGSY built its cloud ERP platform entirely on Google Cloud so project-based companies can manage the full lead-to-cash cycle across multiple countries and currencies. The application estate spans App Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Firebase, and Firestore in Datastore mode, with Google Workspace and Workspace Marketplace supporting user workflows and distribution. On top of that core SaaS platform, VOGSY is adding Gemini, Vertex AI, and Agent Development Kit (ADK) capabilities for AI assistant, project-risk prediction, and budget-forecasting features. This architecture keeps the operational footprint lean while giving the team a cloud-native foundation that has maintained zero downtime since launch. By combining transactional ERP workflows, BI, and new AI features on one stack, VOGSY can keep innovating without moving to a more complex platform.

solution_components.name: App Engine
solution_components.role: Runs parts of the ERP application's cloud-native business logic.

solution_components.name: Google Kubernetes Engine
solution_components.role: Provides container orchestration for the ERP platform as it scales globally.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run
solution_components.role: Supports additional cloud-native services in the ERP estate.

solution_components.name: Cloud Storage
solution_components.role: Stores application data and assets used by the SaaS platform.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Supports analytics and reporting for the ERP environment.

solution_components.name: Firebase
solution_components.role: Provides supporting application services for the platform.

solution_components.name: Firestore in Datastore mode
solution_components.role: Supplies managed data services used by the ERP platform.

solution_components.name: Google Workspace (G Suite)
solution_components.role: Connects the ERP workflows to the collaboration environment customers already use.

solution_components.name: Workspace Marketplace
solution_components.role: Supports distribution and customer access to VOGSY's application ecosystem.

solution_components.name: Gemini
solution_components.role: Provides the AI foundation for assistant, forecasting, and project health features.

solution_components.name: Vertex AI
solution_components.role: Hosts advanced AI capabilities VOGSY plans to use for new intelligent ERP features.

solution_components.name: Agent Development Kit (ADK)
solution_components.role: Supports the agent-based AI features VOGSY is integrating into the platform.

solution_components.name: Looker
solution_components.role: Adds enterprise BI capabilities on top of the ERP data model.

data_flow: Lead-to-cash data from globally distributed project businesses flows through VOGSY's cloud-native application services on App Engine, GKE, and Cloud Run, persists in Firestore, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery, and is surfaced through Google Workspace, Looker, and newer Gemini- and ADK-based AI features for analysis and action.
business_outcome: VOGSY has maintained zero downtime since launch, supports globally distributed project businesses at competitive cost, and helped one international customer cut month-end close across five entities from two weeks to one or two days.
metrics: Maintained zero downtime since inception and achieved infinite scalability (both functional and technical)
one international client reduced their month-end financial close across five global entities from a two-week ordeal to just one or two days
saving 4-6 days of senior finance time every month
The team currently consists of 16 employees and serves about 60 clients worldwide.

The platform spans App Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Firestore in Datastore mode, and Vertex AI services.
Looker is used for enterprise BI on top of the ERP data.
The company plans to pursue ISO 42001 as it expands responsible enterprise AI features.
